systems.name: Scaffold, attribution, pack script
systems.smoke: python3 tools/pack-tfc.py writes mods/tfc/dist/tfc.hmod with POSIX paths, horizon-mod.toml, and horizon-native.json. Join a world and expect the TFC Horizon 0.2.0 login line.

systems.name: Calendar, thin climate, thirst
systems.smoke: Action bar updates every 40 ticks with season, month, °C, thirst, and G/F/V/P/D. Thirst reaches 0 after 24000 ticks and chat says to drink. Hold-use tfc:jug or tfc:wooden_bucket (32 ticks) and thirst rises; the vessel stays.

systems.name: Rock and ore slice, prospector
systems.smoke: /give @s tfc:andesite_raw and /give @s tfc:ore_native_copper. Place the ore, hold tfc:prospector_pick, and right-click it: chat names native copper and a local rock preview.

systems.name: Knapping stand-in, stone tools, firepit
systems.smoke: Stone tools are a knapped head plus a stick (W19), not andesite cobble plus a stick. Craft and place tfc:firepit, fuel it with coal or a log in slot 0, put minecraft:beef in the input, and take tfc:cooked_meat.

systems.name: Clay, pottery, pit kiln, charcoal pit
systems.smoke: Craft tfc:unfired_vessel from clay balls. Place tfc:pit_kiln, insert the unfired vessel, and take tfc:vessel. Place tfc:charcoal_pit, insert minecraft:oak_log, and take minecraft:charcoal.

systems.name: Charcoal forge and copper cast
systems.smoke: Place tfc:charcoal_forge with fuel in slot 0. Smelt tfc:nugget_native_copper into tfc:copper_ingot, then cast tfc:copper_axe_head and craft it with a stick into tfc:copper_axe.

systems.name: Bloomery, anvil, welding stand-in
systems.smoke: Bloomery turns tfc:nugget_hematite into tfc:raw_iron_bloom. The anvil turns that bloom into tfc:wrought_iron_ingot only after the hammer steps in W18, and an ingot into a sheet the same way. Two copper ingots become tfc:copper_double_ingot in the forge at weld heat (W18), not in the crafting grid.

systems.name: Food size, weight, five nutrients
systems.smoke: Hold-use tfc:bread or tfc:cooked_meat for 32 ticks. The stack shrinks, the nutrient letters on the action bar move, and the tooltip shows size, weight, and decay days.

systems.name: Per-stack rot timer
systems.smoke: Decay days are shown on the tooltip. A creation-tick on the stack needs an item-component write this pin does not use, so food does not turn into rot.

systems.name: Crops with season and temperature gate
systems.smoke: Place tfc:crop_wheat. In summer (absolute day 48 at this calendar, about 26C) growth advances every 200 ticks and the output slot fills with tfc:wheat at 7. In January (day 0, about 6C, winter) growth stays put. Barley accepts spring and autumn, not summer.

systems.name: Quern and barrel
systems.smoke: Quern grinds tfc:wheat into tfc:flour and tfc:limestone_gravel into tfc:flux. Barrel turns minecraft:oak_log into tfc:tannin.

systems.name: Lumber, log pile, support warning
systems.smoke: Craft tfc:lumber from an oak log and tfc:support_beam from lumber. Log pile opens 9 slots. Break a tfc rock that has another tfc rock above it and no adjacent support beam: chat warns that the upper rock is unsupported.

systems.name: Replace unsupported rock with cobble
systems.smoke: set_block needs a BlockStateId. default_state is API 446, after hooks 411, so the warning does not change the block.

systems.name: Pan and sluice
systems.smoke: Right-click with tfc:pan and chat points at the sluice. Craft tfc:ore_deposit from gravel + pan. Sluice turns that deposit into tfc:nugget_native_copper.

systems.name: Blast furnace and brass
systems.smoke: Blast furnace with fuel, tfc:wrought_iron_ingot, and tfc:flux yields tfc:steel_ingot. Brass is the crucible ratio in W17, not a crafting grid. Forge also melts tin, bismuth, silver, and gold nuggets once Heat reaches the metal.

systems.name: Animals
systems.smoke: tables/animals.json lists cow, sheep, pig, chicken, horse, wolf, deer, and fish. No entity is spawned. Login line says animals are deferred.

systems.name: Full rock layers, climate maps, biomes, veins
systems.smoke: No chunk hook places rocks. Prospect chat names a stable preview rock from tables/worldgen.json. The planned layer list is in that file. Place the eight content rocks and eight ores by hand or /give.

systems.name: Glass, chisel, powderkeg, JEI recipe types
systems.smoke: Craft tfc:glass_batch from sand + flux and fire it in the pit kiln to minecraft:glass. Right-click a tfc rock with a chisel for the mark line. Right-click tfc:powderkeg — fuse is #1 (Host has no explode/schedule_block_tick on hooks 411). Custom recipe types tfc:firepit, tfc:charcoal_forge, tfc:pit_kiln, tfc:quern, tfc:barrel, tfc:bloomery, tfc:anvil, tfc:sluice, tfc:charcoal_pit, and tfc:blast_furnace are in data/tfc/recipe for JEI once the content snapshot loads.

systems.name: Charcoal forge heat gate
systems.smoke: Place tfc:charcoal_forge with fuel in slot 0. Heat on the block rises by 20 degrees per burning tick and stops at forge_max 1400. tfc:nugget_native_copper becomes tfc:copper_ingot only after Heat reaches 1080 and the 160-tick duration finishes. tfc:nugget_cassiterite reaches its 230 threshold sooner, so a tin run finishes before a copper run. tfc:nugget_hematite stays in the slot: wrought iron melts at 1535, above the forge cap, so that forge recipe never completes. Bloomery still turns the same nugget into tfc:raw_iron_bloom.

systems.name: Crucible bronze and brass
systems.smoke: Place tfc:crucible with fuel. 8 tfc:copper_ingot plus 1 tfc:tin_ingot is 88.9 percent copper, inside the 88-92 window. After Heat reaches bronze 950 and 200 ticks, the output is 9 tfc:bronze_ingot. 1 copper ingot plus 1 tin ingot stays in the slots. Brass is 8 copper plus 1 tfc:zinc_ingot the same way. Shapeless alloy_bronze and alloy_brass are gone.

systems.name: Anvil steps and forge weld
systems.smoke: Put tfc:raw_iron_bloom in tfc:anvil. Sneak-hit with a hammer to cycle the plan; a normal hit performs the next step from tables/anvil.json (hit, draw, upset). The last step yields tfc:wrought_iron_ingot. An ingot plan yields a sheet or a tool head the same way. The anvil does not finish by itself. Two tfc:copper_ingot in the forge at copper weld temperature 650 yield tfc:copper_double_ingot. Shapeless weld_copper and weld_bronze are gone.

systems.name: Knapping grid
systems.smoke: Craft tfc:knapping from andesite cobble and place it. Fill the 5x5 grid with tfc:andesite_cobble using the axe mask 0010001110001000010000100 from tables/knapping.json. After 20 ticks the output slot is tfc:stone_axe_head. Craft that head with a stick into tfc:stone_axe. Shapeless andesite cobble plus stick no longer makes stone tools. The screen is 25 input slots plus one output.

systems.name: Rot inside a vessel or barrel
systems.smoke: Craft tfc:small_vessel from tfc:vessel and place it. Put tfc:bread in a slot. Bread spoils in 6 days and each day is 200 ticks, so after 1200 ticks the slot becomes tfc:rot. The same bread in the player inventory does not change. Bread in tfc:barrel, which has no barrel recipe, also becomes rot. w7_stack_rot stays blocked.

systems.name: Rain gate, oat, rye, onion, squash
systems.smoke: Place tfc:crop_rye. On day 0 (January, winter, about 6C) growth advances; on day 48 (July, summer, about 26C) it stays put. Quern grinds tfc:oat_grain and tfc:rye_grain into tfc:flour. Firepit cooks tfc:squash into tfc:cooked_squash. tfc:crop_onion needs rainfall of at least 400: at x=0,z=0 rainfall is 300 and it does not grow; at x=2,z=0 rainfall is 420. mods/tfc/tools/test_logic.py checks that column.

systems.name: Version 0.2.0 and pack check
systems.smoke: python3 mods/tfc/tools/check.py passes with catalog 0.2.0 on Horizon fdc87aecdbd116bf1e08adcd062fcbaea8c2e2ca. The login line says TFC Horizon 0.2.0. The hmod is not copied onto tfg-horizon.
